summary.zh: 从提交与 PR 自动生成变更日志
summary.en: Generate changelogs from commits, pull requests, and releases.

description.zh: 依据提交、PR 和发布记录整理出符合 Keep a Changelog 格式的变更日志，并把提交信息的写法统一起来。适合搭建发布流程、为新版本补写说明，或规范团队的提交约定。
description.en: Builds Keep a Changelog entries from commits, pull requests, and release notes, and normalizes commit messages along the way. Fits release workflows, version write-ups, and fixing how a team commits.
